sql:
SELECT
  f,
  ML.QUANTILE_BUCKETIZE(f, 3) OVER() AS bucket,
  ML.QUANTILE_BUCKETIZE(f, 3, "bucket_ranges") OVER() AS bucket_ranges,
  ML.QUANTILE_BUCKETIZE(f, 3, "bucket_ranges_json") OVER() AS bucket_ranges_json
FROM
  UNNEST([1,2,3,4,5]) AS f
ORDER BY f
